name: spark-chart
title: Spark Chart
description: A compact watchlist where each entry pairs a ticker and name with a tiny sparkline — filled area, line or bars — and a live price with its percentage change, updating every moment.
use: A dashboard row needs to show a value and its trend at a glance, without the space of a full chart.
avoid: They have no axes or tooltips, so they show shape but not exact readings, suiting trends rather than analysis.
a11y: The sparklines are unlabelled SVGs with no role, title or data table, so a screen reader only gets the price text beside them. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded card headed 'Watchlist' with a pulsing green Live dot. Four rows each show a ticker and company name, a small sparkline in the middle, and a price above a coloured percentage on the right; the charts are green area, pink line, blue bars and violet area.
behaves: Prices and percentages update continuously, and each sparkline redraws to the new series, sliding its oldest point off. Green marks a rise and pink a fall, while the Live dot pulses.
customise: Pass data, index key, category keys, colour names, Y-domain options, null handling and area fill style; bar gap and stack type are also props, while sizes are fixed classes.
weight: light: Four small SVG sparklines; no chart animation, only cheap redraws on new data.
demo: Watchlist of NVDA Nvidia, AAPL Apple, MSFT Microsoft and AMZN Amazon with prices around $180-247.
polishWhy: Clean, legible KPI rows with coherent colours; the sparklines are stock Tremor with no axis context.
